principle: Surfaces exchange references and context, never duplicated canonical records.

resolution.resourceId: resolve through canonical by-id resource index
resolution.targetSurface: controls destination context only, never ownership
resolution.circularReference: allowed only as navigation relation; recursive content expansion forbidden

churchBibleStudyToEmmaus.rule: Bible Study opens the same Emmaus study system; no duplicate church-study corpus is created.

cinemaToEmmaus.rule: A film, series or episode may expose Scripture coordinates that resolve into Emmaus study context.

magazineComposition.rule: Magazine may select resources from any canonical surface domain while retaining only issue/section/story editorial context.

sermonMedia.rule: Audio/video is attached to sermon identity; media format does not become a cross-surface owner.

continuation.purpose: Allow continue-reading, continue-teaching and watch-next without coupling surfaces.
continuation.rule: Continuation state references canonical ids and surface context only.

guardrails: No surface imports another surface's rendered page as data.
No cross-surface relation depends on CSS, templates, DOM structure or route-specific visual composition.
A reference may carry context but cannot mutate canonical ownership.
Recursive expansion across surfaces is prohibited; resolve one hop at a time.
Legacy Website, Video, Podcast and About identities cannot be cross-surface targets.
